//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are delivery cues, and never captioned; '...' and em dashes are beats. At Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level. Round 3, 2026-11-27: drafted by x-ai/grok-4.7 from a brief that says exactly when each line plays, what is on the TV and what follows (reveal lines hand off to the fun fact; hello introduces Salty, explains the rules and hands off to question one), merged with round 2's best jokes and edited by hand. Upbeat: Salty grins while roasting. Gender-neutral (a woman or a man may voice Salty). Little-turn lines are unchanged. Original character, no real people.

lines.text: I'm Salty! Former captain, current prisoner of this couch. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and fast taps score more. Here we go!
Ahoy! I'm Salty. The TV asks, your phone answers, and quick fingers get the glory. [whispers] Don't cheer early.
I'm Salty, and I have never been more ready. Question up there, answer in your hand, speedy taps win. Incoming!
I'm Salty, and this room smells like guesses. The TV asks, you answer on your phone, and the fast ones get to gloat. Eyes front.
I'm Salty. Lost a ship, kept the ego. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and speed is the whole flex. Let's see it.
Welcome, overconfident bunch! I'm Salty. Screen asks, phone answers, and speed separates legends from furniture. Go.
Welcome, you beautiful disasters! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and the fast ones get to be insufferable. Let's go.
I'm Salty. The TV is about to ask, your phone is about to judge you, and hesitation is a damn hobby. Eyes up.
I'm Salty. Former captain, current couch hostage. Question up top, answer on your phone, speed scores. Hell yes, roll it.
I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and the fast bastards get to gloat. Let's fucking go.
I'm Salty. The TV throws the question, your phone takes the blame, and speed is how you fake being smart. Incoming.
I'm Salty. Captain of jack shit, host of... this. Question on the TV, answer on your phone, fast wins. Drink later, watch now.
Grab a phone, scan that code, or type the letters like a tiny hero. I'll be here, sparkling.
Phones out! Scan the code or spell the letters, and come aboard before the parrot sends a postcard.
Still hovering? Scan the code or type the letters. [whispers] The snacks are getting ideas.
Those letters are an invitation, not homework. Scan or type, and hop in!
That code is not wallpaper. Grab a phone and scan it, or type the letters before I roast the empty hands.
Still joining? Hit the code or the letters, and stop lurking like a houseplant.
Scan it, type it, join it. Grab a phone before this turns into a meeting.
Players, now. Scan the code before I start quizzing the throw pillows. [mischievously] They cheat.
That square is a door. Scan it, or type the letters, and stop camping in the lobby.
Grab a phone and scan the damn code, or type the letters if you're feeling artisanal. Get in.
Phones out. Scan or type... hell, do it before the snacks file a complaint.
No phone? Borrow one and owe them a legend. Scan the code. Get in here.
Grab a phone and scan the fucking code, or type the letters if you enjoy suffering. Get in here.
That square is not flirting. Scan it, or type the letters, and stop lingering like a bad decision.
Phones out, bastards. Scan the code or peck the letters before I start charging rent.
If a code defeats you, tonight's guesses are going to be a shitshow. Scan it. Get in.
Look who showed up! The new one, fashionably glowing.
The new one is here, and the room just got brighter.
Ah, the new one! Act like we planned this.
Oh good, the new one. We needed another opinion with thumbs.
The new one just joined, and I can already smell a rivalry.
The new one is in. Nobody panic. [mischievously] Or do, it's funnier.
Oh hell, the new one is here. Act like you've got a plan.
The new one walked in, and suddenly everybody's strategy is crap.
The new one just joined, and I respect the audacity already.
Oh shit, the new one is here. Everybody pretend you're clever.
Ah, the new one. The only one who hasn't fucked up yet.
The new one just joined, and the night got worse in a fun way.
Eyes up, thumbs ready... something sneaky's coming.
Don't get cozy. [whispers] This one's grinning.
Fresh round, big grins. Stay sharp!
New round. Your luck just flinched.
Fresh round. Pretend you studied. Cute.
Eyes up. [mischievously] This one bites.
New round. Try not to choke.
Don't get cocky. The screen is mean.
Hell of a round coming. Lock in.
New round. Don't fuck it up.
Brains on, drinks down. Listen.
Fresh round. That last guess was shit.
I can hear the guessing from here.
Don't overthink it into pudding.
Quiet brains. Loud thumbs.
That hesitation is hilarious. Commit.
The phone can feel fear. Tap.
[whispers] Tap before your courage leaves.
[scoffs] Your pause just confessed.
Commit, damn it. Tap.
Think faster. The doubt is crap.
That pause is fucking suspicious.
Stop flirting with the wrong answer.
Tap before regret pulls up a chair.
A perfect sweep! [gasps] I might frame this.
Not a miss in the house. The thumbs threw a parade.
Everyone nailed it! Unreasonably lovely.
Everyone got it. Disgustingly competent.
All correct. Your group chat is going to be unbearable.
Every phone agrees. That's skill... or a pact.
All correct. I had a roast loaded. Rude.
Everyone's right. I'm irritated and a little proud.
A perfect sweep. Hell of a flex.
Everyone got it. What the fuck, that was clean.
All correct. I had a roast loaded and everything.
Clean sweep. I'm pissed I can't tease a single one of you.
Nobody got it! The question wins, grinning.
Not a correct tap in the room. [gasps] The screen giggled.
All wrong, all together. That's teamwork... sort of.
Not a soul. [deadpan] Peak confidence.
Everyone whiffed. The phones are filing complaints.
All wrong. Your certainty was a costume.
All wrong. Your confidence was crap in a trench coat.
Nobody got it. Damn, that was a group project.
Everyone whiffed. The phones deserve hazard pay.
All wrong. Your certainty was shit in a nice jacket.
Nobody got it. What the shit was that?
A sweep of wrong. You bastards really committed, though.
Some of you soared. Some waved from the puddle.
A few nailed it. The rest brought enthusiasm!
Right over here, wrong over there. Very living room.
Some got it. Some performed confidence instead.
Some phones are smug. The others are writing a novel.
Right side, wrong side. [mischievously] The tension is delicious.
Some got it. Some brought pure crap confidence.
Some soared. The rest swung at open air.
Winners glowing, misses fuming. I live for this.
Some got it. Some guessed like the bar was closing.
Divided as fuck. [laughs] I respect both disasters.
Some of you nailed it. The rest can drink about it.
Take a bow, winner! Everybody else, take the hugs. I'm Salty, signing off before the couch claims me.
Winner on top, glowing like a birthday candle. The rest of you were delightful turbulence. Goodnight, crew!
Winner, enjoy the glow. Everyone else, your guesses had personality. That was a blast!
Look at the winner, already composing the speech. Everyone else, your confidence needs a nap. Night!
Winner's on top, smirk legally required. The rest of you were loud, wrong, and weirdly charming. I'm Salty. Don't text me.
Top of the board earned it. The rest of you earned a story you'll tell wrong. I'm out, legends.
Look at the winner, already unbearable. Everyone else, that was a hell of a fumble montage. Night!
Winner's on top, damn right. The rest of you were chaos with thumbs. I'm Salty, and the lobby's closed.
The winner's smug, and correctly. The rest of you brought heat and very little accuracy. Bye!
Look at the winner, already insufferable. Everyone else, that was a shitshow with phones. I loved it. Night!
Winner, take the bow. Everybody else, the misses were bold and fucking wrong. I'm Salty. Go make worse choices.
Winner's on top, you beautiful bastard. The rest of you guessed like the night was already over. That was fucking fun.
Special turn! [whispers] Take your time, buddy.
Shhh! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Which picture is it?
Here's the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet! No helping. Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me.
YES! [gasps] You're smarter than me!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I need sunglasses!
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would!
That's the one! Everybody cheer! Louder!
Right again! You be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
So close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! It was this one. That was a hard one!
Oopsie! Great picking, though! Here's the right one.
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time.
Nice try, buddy! Tricky one. Points for being awesome!
Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
[whispers] Look at your phone. Don't react. ...You reacted. Lovely.
Welcome to my manor. I own it. Mostly. Don't open the west wing.
[whispers] Someone here is a Snake. I picked them. I regret it already.
Welcome, guests. One of you is a Snake, and I've hidden the good silverware. Damn shame.
Welcome to my manor. One of you is a Snake. I picked them. What the hell was I thinking? Shit.
A mission! Fill my pot with crowns. Our pot. Your pot. Fine.
A mission. Answer well and the pot grows. Answer badly and I sulk.
Brains out, guests. The pot is hungry and so am I.
Mission time. Somebody's going to tank this on purpose. Act surprised.
Mission time. Get it right, or get it wrong on purpose. Either way, I'm drinking. Shit.
[gasps] One answer went overboard! I didn't see whose. I was polishing a spoon.
[gasps] An answer went overboard! Splash. Nobody saw anything. Least of all me.
One answer went overboard. Hell of a coincidence. I'm sure it was the wind.
One answer got chucked overboard. Holy shit. Somebody's playing dirty.
Target hit! The pot is fat and happy. So am I.
Target hit! Either nobody's a Snake, or the Snakes are terrible at this.
Target hit. Damn fine work. Suspiciously fine. I'm watching all of you.
Target hit. Holy shit, that actually worked. The Snakes are furious. Good.
[sighs] Target missed. The Snakes are smiling. I can hear it.
Target missed. Someone sank that on purpose. The Snakes earn a Dagger. I hide.
Missed it. That wasn't bad luck, that was a Snake. They've got a Dagger now. Hell.
Missed the damn target. Now there's a Dagger loose in my manor. Shit.
Gather round the Round Table. Be fair. Be dramatic. Be quick.
Sit. Accuse. Be dramatic. I'll be over here, being more dramatic.
The Round Table. Point fingers. Not that one. That's rude.
Round Table. Accuse each other. Loudly. I love this part. It's free theatre.
Round Table. Go on, tear into it. I've got popcorn and zero fucking idea.
Seal your vote on your phone. Secretly. Like a spy. A nice spy.
Seal your votes. No peeking. I'm peeking. I'm allowed. It's my manor.
Seal your votes. Choose wisely, or at least choose dramatically.
Seal your damn votes. Somebody leaves my manor tonight. I'm not crying. Shit, I'm crying.
A tie! Vote again, just between the two of them. Ooh, tense.
A tie. Of course it's a tie. Vote again. Between those two. No pressure.
A tie. Hell. Vote again, between the tied. Somebody break it.
A fucking tie. Vote again, between those two. Pick one.
Let's break the seals. One... at... a... time.
The seals. One at a time. I've waited all day for this. All year, really.
Breaking the seals. Somebody's about to feel very betrayed. Delicious.
Breaking the seals. Holy shit, I love this part.
Nobody voted? Not one seal? [sighs] Fine. Nobody goes.
No votes. Nobody. You'd rather keep the Snake than pick one. Cowards. Adorable cowards.
No votes. Not one. Hell of a strategy. Nobody leaves.
Not a single damn vote. Unbelievable. Nobody leaves. Fuck me.
[whispers] The one we sent home... was...
[whispers] The one we showed the door... was...
[whispers] I can't look. Somebody tell me. ...Fine. They were...
[whispers] The one we cast out... was...
[whispers] The one we threw out... was...
A Snake! Hooray! I knew it. I didn't know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! I knew it. I did not know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! Damn right. Get out of my manor.
A Snake! Fuck yes. I knew it. I absolutely did not know it.
[sighs] A Guest. Oh dear. Say sorry. Somebody say sorry.
[sighs] A Guest. You threw out an innocent Guest. Enjoy the guilt. It's complimentary.
A Guest. Damn. You threw out an innocent. The Snakes are laughing at you.
A Guest. Oh, shit. The Snakes are laughing their asses off.
[whispers] Lights out. Phones in hand. Shh.
[whispers] Lights out. If you hear hissing, it's the radiator. Probably.
[whispers] Night falls on the manor. I'll be in the wardrobe. Don't look for me.
[whispers] Night. Say nothing. Somebody won't see breakfast. Hell of a house rule.
[whispers] Night. Phones down. No, up. Phones up. Shit. Somebody's skipping breakfast.
Good morning! Well, mostly. Someone vanished in the night. Spooky.
Good morning! Not for everyone. Someone vanished in the night. I hid in a wardrobe. Very brave.
Rise and shine! Someone didn't. They vanished in the night. I'm fine. I'm totally fine.
Good morning. We lost one in the night. Murdered. I fainted twice. Damn.
Morning. Somebody got murdered in the night. Pass the fucking toast.
Nobody vanished! A shield held. Hooray for shields!
Nobody died! A shield, a miracle, or the Snakes overslept.
Nobody murdered. A shield held. The Snakes are damn furious.
Nobody died. A shield held. Holy shit, a happy ending.
A quiet night. Everyone's here. Isn't that nice?
A quiet night. Nobody vanished. That's worse, somehow. What are they planning?
Nobody died last night. Which means something worse happened. Hell.
A quiet night. Nobody died. That's never good news. Shit.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. [whispers] Somebody new is one now.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I may have... appointed one. Sorry.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I recruited a new one. Damn, I'm good.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I made a new one. Don't fucking ask.
Good morning, guests.
Morning. Coffee's cold. Everyone count your friends.
Morning. Count heads. Damn it, count them again.
Morning. Count heads. Count them again. Shit.
Here we are. End the game, or banish again? Everyone must agree to end it.
The last table. End it now, or banish again. All of you must say End. All of you.
The last table. End it, or one more banishment. Choose. Damn carefully.
The last table. End it, or one more fucking betrayal. I'm hiding either way.
Time to see who's who. Masks off!
The unmasking. One at a time. I've been waiting all night for this.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying through their damn teeth.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying all damn night. Holy shit.
The Guests win! Share the crowns. I'll be keeping the candelabra.
The Guests win! The Snakes are out. I was never scared. I was very scared.
The Guests win. Damn fine sleuthing. Take the money. Not the candelabra.
The Guests win! Holy shit, justice. Take the crowns. Leave the candelabra.
The Snakes win! Sneaky, sneaky. Clap for the sneakies.
The Snakes win. Take the money. Not the candelabra. Oh no. They took the candelabra.
The Snakes win. They lied to your faces and took the damn pot.
The Snakes win. They took the whole damn pot. I'm weirdly proud. Fuck.
